V9 generic man selected but do not say proper-name use impossible by a universal article rule. V10 Spanish Te oí is an idiomatic rendering of hearing qôl, leaving noun implicit: assess whether natural and adequate; English sound of you aims to preserve sound/voice openness. Do not add psychological guilt or a certain chronology. Return JSON {opinions:[{id,verdict,final_opinion_ko,counterargument_ko}],final_opinion_ko}; exactly Gen.3.6-10.
